title: Cisco ISE security basics
description: Spot attacks on the system that decides who gets on the network: bursts of failed RADIUS logins, locked ISE admin accounts, privileged TACACS+ commands on network devices, quarantine actions, and brute force against the ISE APIs.

splunkbaseApps.displayName: Splunk Add-on for Cisco Identity Services

requiredData.notes: Configure ISE remote logging targets to send the Passed/Failed Authentications, Administrative and Operational Audit, and TACACS accounting categories to Splunk with sourcetype cisco:ise:syslog, and install the Splunk Add-on for Cisco Identity Services.

industrySources.control: Cisco ISE alarms: Excessive Failed Attempts, Administrator account Locked/Disabled, Excessive TACACS Authentication Failed Attempts, ERS input suspect for injection
